name: Tandemaus
flavor: The pair sticks together no matter what. They split any food they find exactly in half and then eat it together.
ability: You start knowing how many pairs of evil players there are.

name: Growlithe
flavor: A Pokémon with a friendly nature. However, it will bark fiercely at anything invading its territory.
ability: You start knowing that 1 of 2 players is a particular Minion.
firstNightReminder: Show the Minion character token. Point to both the *MINION* and *WRONG* players.

name: Panpour
flavor: The water stored inside the tuft on its head is full of nutrients. Plants that receive its water grow large.
ability: You start knowing that 1 of 2 players is a particular Townsfolk.
firstNightReminder: Show the Townsfolk character token. Point to both the *TOWNSFOLK* and *WRONG* players.

name: Tangela
flavor: It tangles any moving thing with its vines. Their subtle shaking is ticklish if you get ensnared.
ability: You start knowing that 1 of 2 players is a particular Outsider. (Or that zero are in play.)
firstNightReminder: Show the Outsider character token. Point to both the *OUTSIDER* and *WRONG* players.

name: Audino
flavor: This Pokémon has a kind heart. By touching with its feelers, Audino can gauge other creatures’ feelings and physical conditions.
ability: Each night, you learn how many of your 2 alive neighbors are evil.

name: Xatu
flavor: Xatu is known to stand motionless while staring at the sun all day long. Some people revere it as a mystical Pokémon out of their belief that Xatu is in possession of the power to see into the future.
ability: Each night, choose 2 players: you learn if either is a Demon. There is a good player that registers as a Demon to you.
firstNightReminder: Xatu chooses 2 players. Nod if either is the Demon (or the *RED HERRING*).
otherNightReminder: Xatu chooses 2 players. Nod if either is the Demon (or the *RED HERRING*).

name: Dusknoir
flavor: It is said to take lost spirits into its pliant body and guide them home.
ability: Each night*, you learn which character died by execution today.
otherNightReminder: If a player was executed today, show their character token.

name: Cresselia
flavor: Those who sleep holding Cresselia’s feather are assured of joyful dreams. It is said to represent the crescent moon.
ability: Each night*, choose a player (not yourself): they are safe from the Demon tonight.

name: Gallade
flavor: Because it can sense what its foe is thinking, its attacks burst out first, fast, and fierce.
ability: Once per game, during the day, publicly choose a player: if they are the Demon, they die.

name: Lucario
flavor: It’s said that no foe can remain invisible to Lucario, since it can detect auras—even those of foes it could not otherwise see.
ability: You are safe from the Demon.

name: Vespiquen
flavor: It houses its colony in cells in its body and releases various pheromones to make those grubs do its bidding.
ability: If you die at night, you are woken to choose a player: you learn their character.
otherNightReminder: If Vespiquen died tonight, Vespiquen chooses a player. Show that player's character token.

name: Pikachu
flavor: Its nature is to store up electricity. Forests where nests of Pikachu live are dangerous, since the trees are so often struck by lightning.
ability: If only 3 players live & no execution occurs, your team wins. If you die at night, another player might die instead.

name: Togepi
flavor: The shell seems to be filled with joy. It is said that it will share good luck when treated kindly.
ability: The 1st time you are nominated, if the nominator is a Townsfolk, they are executed immediately.

name: Mime Jr.
flavor: It mimics the expressions and motions of those it sees to understand the feelings of others.

jinxes.reason: If the Organ Grinder is causing eyes closed voting, Mime Jr. may raise their hand to vote but their vote is only counted if their master voted too.

ability: Each night, choose a player (not yourself): tomorrow, you may only vote if they are voting too.

name: Spinda
flavor: Its steps are staggering and unsteady, but Spinda thinks it's walking in a straight line.
ability: You do not know you are Spinda. You think you are a Townsfolk character, but you are not.

name: Absol
flavor: It appears when it senses an impending natural disaster. As a result, it was mistaken as a doom-bringer.

jinxes.reason: If Absol registers as evil to the Ogre, the Ogre learns that they are evil.
Absol might register as the Demon to the Sage.

ability: You might register as evil & as a Minion or Demon, even if dead.

name: Electrode
flavor: It stores an overflowing amount of electric energy inside its body. Even a small shock makes it explode.
ability: If you die by execution, your team loses.

name: Toxapex
flavor: Within the poison sac in its body is a poison so toxic that Pokémon as large as Wailord will still be suffering three days after it first takes effect.
ability: Each night, choose a player: they are poisoned tonight and tomorrow day.

name: Zoroark
flavor: Each has the ability to fool a large group of people simultaneously. They protect their lair with illusory scenery.

jinxes.reason: If Zoroark is (or has been) in play, the Damsel is poisoned.
Zoroark registers as evil to the Ogre.
If the Poppy Grower has their ability, Zoroark does not see the Grimoire.

ability: Each night, you see the Grimoire. You might register as good & as a Townsfolk or Outsider, even if dead.
firstNightReminder: Show the Grimoire for as long as Zoroark needs.
otherNightReminder: Show the Grimoire for as long as Zoroark needs.

name: Gothitelle
flavor: Gothitelle unleashes psychic energy and shows opponents dreams of the universe’s end. These dreams are apparently ethereal and beautiful.

jinxes.reason: If there would be two Demons, one of which was Gothitelle, Gothitelle becomes Gothitelle again.
If there would be two Demons, one of which was Gothitelle, Gothitelle remains as Gothitelle.

ability: If there are 5 or more players alive & the Demon dies, you become the Demon. (Travellers don't count.)
otherNightReminder: If Gothitelle became the Demon today, show them the *YOU ARE* token, then the Demon token.

name: Honchkrow
flavor: It will absolutely not forgive failure from or betrayal by its goons. It has no choice in this if it wants to maintain the order of the flock.
ability: There are extra Outsiders in play. [+2 Outsiders]

name: Darkrai
flavor: It chases people and Pokémon from its territory by causing them to experience deep, nightmarish slumbers.
ability: Each night*, choose a player: they die. If you kill yourself this way, a Minion becomes Darkrai.
otherNightReminder: Darkrai chooses a player. :reminder: If Darkrai chose themselves: Replace 1 alive Minion token with a spare Darkrai token. Put the old Darkrai to sleep. Wake the new Darkrai. Show the *YOU ARE* token, then show the Darkrai token.

name: Noctowl
flavor: If it flips its head upside down, it's a sign that it is engaged in very complex thinking.
ability: Each night, choose a player (not yourself): their vote counts as 3 votes tomorrow.

name: Thievul
flavor: It secretly marks potential targets with a scent. By following the scent, it stalks its targets and steals from them when they least expect it.
ability: Each night, choose a player (not yourself): their vote counts negatively tomorrow.

name: Inteleon
flavor: Its nictitating membranes let it pick out foes' weak points so it can precisely blast them with water that shoots from its fingertips at Mach 3.
ability: Each day, after the 1st vote has been tallied, you may choose a player that voted: they die.

name: Gimmighoul
flavor: This Pokémon was born inside a treasure chest about 1,500 years ago. It sucks the life-force out of scoundrels who try to steal the treasure.
ability: You must use a vote token to vote. If a dead player gives you theirs, you learn their alignment. You are sober & healthy.

name: Gogoat
flavor: It can sense the feelings of others by touching them with its horns. This species has assisted people with their work since 5,000 years ago.
ability: If a player of your alignment is executed, you might be executed instead.

name: Pokémania
flavor: Who's that Pokémon?
ability: Every character is a Pokémon! No changes have been made to character abilities.
